quests.title: Route 5: the Pokémon shelter raid (after the Cascade Badge)
Route 11: the Swablu from the shelter

acquisitions.conditions: Pikachu starter only. After the Cascade Badge, intervene in the Route 5 shelter raid and win, then accept the rescued Pokémon inside the house. Refusing the rescue loses it. Complete the raid before making Sabrina laugh in Pokémon Tower. Leave a free party slot.

quests.title: Route 5: the Pokémon shelter raid (after the Cascade Badge)

acquisitions.conditions: Choose this Pokémon as your initial starter at Professor Oak’s Lab. You receive only one of Bulbasaur, Charmander or Pikachu.
